title: Add MCP tool response size limits and truncation metadata
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.3. MCP tool responses currently return unbounded text payloads. Add configurable response cap with deterministic truncation metadata so clients can detect incomplete payloads and request narrower reads.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented MCP-specific response size governance in `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/McpController.cs` and `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithOptions.cs`. `tools/call` responses now clamp text to configurable `MemorySmith:Mcp:MaxToolResponseCharacters` and emit deterministic metadata under `result.meta.memorysmith` with `isTruncated`, `originalCharacters`, `returnedCharacters`, and `maxCharacters`. Added admin exposure in `MemorySmith.App/Services/AdminSettingsService.cs` plus default config in `MemorySmith.App/appsettings.json`. Added focused regression coverage in `MemorySmith.Tests/McpAndSemanticSearchTests.cs` proving oversized payloads truncate and surface metadata. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~McpTools_TruncateOversizedResponsesAndEmitMetadata|Name~McpTools_EmitToolExecutionTelemetry|Name~McpContextPackTool_ReturnsHybridResultsWithLinkedContext|Name~McpToolsList_ExposesWikiSearchTools"` (4/4 passed). Live check: `Invoke-WebRequest https://localhost:7090/health -SkipCertificateCheck` returned `200`.
